About Measured Color

A Vijeron learning resource for explainable interface color decisions.

Purpose

Measured Color helps readers make explainable, testable interface decisions. It is not a WCAG certification service, design agency or color product catalogue.

Publisher

Vijeron publishes this site within its catalog. Referenced organizations are not affiliated with us. Advertising does not alter tool calculations.

Advertising

Google AdSense code is present on content pages. Serving depends on account status and privacy choices; no revenue or placement is promised.

Measured Color
